accessNotes: The three public plan pages still publish the same six EUR list prices per product on 2026-08-27. A temporary Back to Business promotion applies code B2B30 and 30%-off prices; those promotional totals are excluded from the durable list-price capture. The restricted-country article applies to both residency and nationality and lists Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Vietnam and Pakistan; Russia is not named, but this is a published-list observation rather than a guarantee for a specific checkout, sanctions screen or KYC profile. The reward article says the first request is after 30 days and later requests every 14 days while also calling bi-weekly payouts an add-on; that first-party wording conflict remains unresolved. The same article confirms EUR bank transfers, USDC ERC-20 crypto payouts, no minimum Reward, and a conditional 15% evaluation-profit reward after 10% funded growth and an approved payout.

fieldEvidence.refundable: The refund article allows a refund within 30 days only when no trade has been made.

notes: All fees are EUR list prices. Temporary B2B30 promotional pricing is deliberately excluded.
The 6% maximum drawdown trails the highest equity in real time and locks at the original balance after 6% growth.
The base funded reward split is 80%; 90% is a paid add-on and 100% is available only through scaling.
The first standard request is after 30 days and later requests are stated as 14-day cycles, but the same help article calls bi-weekly payouts an add-on; this wording conflict is unresolved.
Bank payouts are processed in EUR, crypto payouts in USDC ERC-20, and the help article publishes no minimum Reward.

A conditional 15% evaluation-profit reward is added to a new funded account only after at least 10% funded growth and an approved payout; it becomes withdrawable on the next payout after an activating trade.
Funded news executions in the 10-minute window lose the related profit; losses remain and the event is treated as a soft breach.
The separately advertised 100% challenge-fee refund is an add-on. The refundable tier flag records the standard unused-account refund within 30 days.
